commit aa5464e7d33b28b2ebf98c8ccef826ccfff5486a
Author: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
Date:   Mon Apr 20 23:17:54 2026 +0000

    fix(opencode): record plan-agent sessions by finalizing turn at session-end
    
    OpenCode's plan agent does not reliably emit session.status {type:"idle"},
    so the plugin's turn-end hook never fires and the transcript is never
    written. Build mode is unaffected.
    
    Rather than adding heuristics on top of OpenCode's event stream, treat
    session-end as the authoritative terminal signal (it fires on
    server.instance.disposed, which is guaranteed on process exit) and have
    the Go-side lifecycle dispatcher finalize the turn there when the
    per-session transcript is still missing. The fallback is a no-op when
    turn-end already succeeded, so it doesn't regress build mode and retires
    automatically if OpenCode ever tightens their idle-event semantics.
    
    - opencode ParseHookEvent: include SessionRef on SessionEnd (matches
      ClaudeCode, required so the fallback knows where to fetch the export).
    - cli lifecycle: add finalizeTurnOnSessionEnd gated on full.jsonl
      absence; synthesizes a TurnEnd and reuses handleLifecycleTurnEnd.
    - tests: cover transcript-missing, transcript-exists, and empty-ref
      branches; tighten the OpenCode SessionEnd parse test.
    
    https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED
    
    Entire-Checkpoint: d536280b7637
